title: Floral Designers
description: Design, cut, and arrange live, dried, or artificial flowers and foliage.

tasks.text: Plan arrangement according to client's requirements, using knowledge of design and properties of materials, or select appropriate standard design pattern.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Concepts generated; commercial curation human

dwas.name: Develop artistic or design concepts for decoration, exhibition, or commercial purposes.

tasks.text: Trim material and arrange bouquets, wreaths, terrariums, and other items, using trimmers, shapers, wire, pins, floral tape, foam, and other materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crafting physical objects is manual artisan work

dwas.name: Construct distinctive physical objects for artistic, functional, or commercial purposes.

tasks.text: Confer with clients regarding price and type of arrangement desired and the date, time, and place of delivery.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Needs elicitation requires human rapport and judgment

dwas.name: Confer with clients to determine needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Perform office and retail service duties, such as keeping financial records, serving customers, answering telephones, selling giftware items, and receiving payment.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain files and records in structured systems

dwas.name: Maintain records, documents, or other files.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Valuation aided; human owns final value judgment

dwas.name: Determine the value of goods or services.
Arrange items for use or display.

tasks.text: Deliver arrangements to customers, or oversee employees responsible for deliveries.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can arrange deliveries; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Arrange delivery of goods or services.

tasks.text: Water plants, and cut, condition, and clean flowers and foliage for storage.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Plant/animal care is physical work with living things

tasks.text: Select flora and foliage for arrangements, working with numerous combinations to synthesize and develop new creations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prop selection depends on creative and physical context

tasks.text: Order and purchase flowers and supplies from wholesalers and growers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Perform general cleaning duties in the store to ensure the shop is clean and tidy.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.

tasks.text: Decorate, or supervise the decoration of, buildings, halls, churches, or other facilities for parties, weddings and other occasions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Arranging props is physical placement work

tasks.text: Inform customers about the care, maintenance, and handling of various flowers and foliage, indoor plants, and other items.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Educational content drafted; public delivery is human

dwas.name: Provide educational information to the public.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Unpack stock as it comes into the shop.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically moving and shelving stock items

tasks.text: Create and change in-store and window displays, designs, and looks to enhance a shop's image.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Concepts generated; commercial curation human

dwas.name: Develop artistic or design concepts for decoration, exhibition, or commercial purposes.

tasks.text: Conduct classes or demonstrations, or train other workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Work-process coaching requires live human interaction
